Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery so we’re aligned on pricing expectations and volumes: 

- Estimated peak traffic: 3–5 rps for chat generation; avg payload ~1.2k tokens per request.
- Monthly token run-rate: ~120M prompt + 180M completions = ~300M tokens/month (rough estimate based on current product roadmap).
- Primary objective: unit economics target of $X / 1M tokens to be competitive with current incumbents (you mentioned benchmarking vs OpenAI / Anthropic and self-hosted/open-model hosts).

Action items I said I’d follow up on:
1) Share a target-price benchmarking sheet comparing Redwood hosted pricing, Redwood Dedicated estimate, and typical OpenAI/Anthropic list prices + common open-model hosting targets. (attached)
2) Run a rough $/1M token cost projection for your reported 300M monthly tokens and two scenarios (low-latency chat, higher-throughput batch embedding flows).
3) Loop in Marissa on contracting path and Neha on SRE/benchmark support if you want an on-prem/Dedicated estimate.

Attached: pricing_sheet_redwood_v2.pdf (high-level price bands), acme_token_benchmarks.xlsx (your volume inputs), redwood_vs_openai_anthropic.csv (public list prices & our target comparisons).

Are you and Jordan available for a 30-min follow-up next week to go over the numbers and discuss a target $/1M tokens that hits your budget? I’m available Mon/Tue 10–12 PT and Wed after 1pm PT.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz

vanessa@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Vanessa — really useful recap and the attachments look good. A few clarifying points from our side: 

- The 300M/month is our high-growth projection (12–18mo). For Q1–Q2 we’d be in the 80–120M/month band while we validate flows.
- Target procurement budget: we need to be <= $5000 / 1M tokens (this is our internal ceiling to evaluate providers) for host-based managed options. If Dedicated or private deployment has fixed infra costs, we can evaluate TCO over a 12-mo commit.
- Latency SLO: 95th pct <= 400ms for short-form chat (prompt+response ~1.2k tokens). Embedding flows can tolerate higher latency.

Let’s do Tue 12/22 10:30am PT for the follow-up; Jordan will bring procurement. Please include Marissa/Neha as discussed.

—Alex
Director of AI Product, Acme Corp

Vanessa / Marissa —

Quick calc notes after reviewing the attached volumes:
- Redwood Hosted (standard): list runs roughly $7.5k / 1M tokens for the chat profile given avg tokens; with standard volume discounts for 100M+ it drops to ~ $6k / 1M.
- To hit $5k / 1M we’d need to: (a) provide a mid-sized committed discount (12-mo commit ~300M/mo) or (b) move to Redwood Dedicated where infra amortization + committed utilization drives cost down.
- Preliminary Dedicated estimate: with a 12-mo reserved capacity + 10% buffer, TCO approximates $3.8k–$4.6k / 1M tokens depending on batching/KV cache effectiveness and whether they accept quantized model variants.

I’ll prepare a short slide with per-scenario $/1M token math and assumptions (latency tradeoffs included). For the Tue call I can present the Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs and the concrete commit thresholds to hit $5k / 1M.

—Neha
